confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of Barcelona prices; no live menus, listings or booking pages were checked. Restaurant and drink anchors are moderately certain; hostel and hotel anchors are less certain because July peak-season rates swing widely. EUR figures were converted at an assumed 1.15 USD per EUR. Cocktail and wine were cross-checked against the beer anchor (cocktail about 3x beer, wine about 1.25x beer) because direct knowledge is weaker. The FX value came from RBA search-result summaries; the RBA page itself was not opened.
comparable_city_reasoning: No external comparable city was used. Estimates reflect Barcelona's own price level from general knowledge, sanity-checked against typical Spanish and Southern European tourist-city pricing.
